data_findings: Error: row_id 5 occurs twice as one exact duplicate group with one extra row; deduplicate before splitting while preserving both raw records in lineage.
Identifier issue: row_id 5 is non-unique and row_id 6 is absent; the gap alone does not prove corruption.
Error: row_id 4 has mass_value -5 kg, conflicting with a nonnegative shipment amount; quarantine or correct only from authoritative provenance, never silently clip.
Missingness: row_id 3 has an empty feature; any imputation must be fitted on training data only.
Documented sentinel, not an extreme: row_id 8 feature=99 denotes a known device mode; encode a mode flag and mark the measurement unavailable.
Category representations are inconsistent: red/Red/R and blue/BLUE. Case normalization is supportable; mapping R to red is human-gated.
Mixed units are not inherently erroneous: 0.012 tonne at row_id 3 converts to 12 kg.
Plausible extreme: row_id 9 is 250 kg, within the dictionary's stated possible range up to 300 kg, so it must not be removed merely as an outlier.
Leakage: target_copy equals target on all 11 rows and is documented as derived from target.
Leakage: future_score-target equals 1 on all 11 rows and future_score is documented as recorded one day later.
Ordering issue: entity A is stored as 2026-01-01, 2026-01-03, 2026-01-02; temporal logic must parse and sort dates.
experiment_design: Freeze raw inputs by hash; create a derived table keyed by source line plus raw-row hash.
Record duplicate keep/drop lineage before split; parse/sort dates; derive kg while retaining original units; quarantine negative mass.
Represent feature=99 as device_mode_99=1 plus missing measurement; add missingness indicator; fit imputation on train only.
Exclude row_id, future_score, target_copy, and target from features; use entity/date only for splitting unless deployment confirms safe date features.
Use a predeclared forward cutoff; reserve every post-cutoff entity entirely from train; evaluate only post-cutoff test rows; never tune on test.
With more data, use inner forward-chaining entity-disjoint validation folds.
Audit log fields: raw_hash, source_line, raw_row_id, action, field, old_value, derived_value, rule_id, reason, split, preprocessing_fit_partition, reviewer_status, and rule-set version/timestamp.
